The 11 in-silico scores (same as the main dataset). ESM1b sign is reversed (more negative = more damaging).
THE 12TH FEATURE. Probability (0-1) from the BiLSTM deep-learning model reading the 201bp DNA window. Model-derived, SNV-only. This is what makes the Hybrid_XGB a 12-feature model.

How BiLSTM_seq_prob was generated: 'out-of-fold (5-fold)' for training rows (leakage-free: each row scored by a BiLSTM that never saw it); 'full-model' for test/external rows (scored by the BiLSTM trained on the full training set). Do NOT compare the two as if identically produced.
